<!-- Adding a theme or a plugin? See CONTRIBUTING.md. 添加主题或插件？见 CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md。 -->

- [ ] One file, named after the theme or the plugin / 一个以主题或插件命名的文件
- [ ] Its latest release carries the zip the studio installs, tagged with its version / 最新版本附带能在后台安装的 zip，tag 就是版本号
- [ ] `kite theme verify` or `kite plugin verify` passes with the latest Kite / 用最新的 Kite 运行 `kite theme verify` 或 `kite plugin verify` 能通过
